method: Two whole source files read. Original complete mdlImg.js executed in Node VM with explicit fake window/document/no_update/React factory; no event handlers or browser/network fired. bu read as source only, never imported or executed.
findings: Original updMdl closed/null branch returns12 outputs while open branch returns14 and reviewed Python callback declares14. Reproduced original callback arrays; no actual Dash callback validation.

Original onModeToggle ignores provided mdl parameter and toggles manager cached state. Input modeH=true following cached false returns true, failing to toggle input state. Reproduced stale-store boundary.

Original onStoreToDummy retains previous currentMdlImgAutoId when multi list exists but current index invalid/empty. Valid asset1 -> empty list keeps1. Space handler can target retained ID. No actual selection event run.

Navigation indexes list position rather than versioned asset identity and builds preview URL from new list; out-of-range and reordered lists can mismatch old imgUrl/current data. Source observation only.
Preview EXIF renders zero-valued location fields as false and skips some rows; image score/metadata tables are presentation helpers, not quality evidence.

bu build helper does not run matcher/model/unit tests before build/push/publish. updateConfVer imports application configuration as a syntax/version check, potentially loading runtime dependencies/side effects rather than syntax-only validation. Source only.

bu publish deletes existing local/remote tag/release after confirmation, ignores several subprocess return values and prints created/pushed messages unconditionally. No tags/releases/branches or external services touched.

bu del protects tag names/version groups but gathers candidate manifest digests without explicit cross-reference against protected tag digests. Shared manifests need separate protection; source concern, no registry calls.
bu interprets HTTP500 manifest-delete response as pending without polling evidence. Deletes can be partially completed with only printed summary, not structured resumable state. No deletion executed.

bu supports credential retrieval; reviewed source only. No credentials/environment/keychain/config files read. Custom tags enter shell command strings; no shell inputs or publishing commands executed.
limits: 101/125 whole tracked blobs reviewed;24 remain (README/LICENSE, CSS/SCSS, socket library and visual assets).
No rendered UI/media/browser, server/model/DB or full upstream suite qualification.
No production code modified/copied, no build/publish/prune/deletion/credential actions.
Native pHash/ASAN remains deferred; full500/all-case library goal remains incomplete.
